title: DevOps Engineer Advanced Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to deepen core DevOps expertise, build showcase projects, and prepare for senior‑level roles. Focuses on leadership, advanced tooling, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations Refresh
phases.summary: Solidify core operating‑system and version‑control concepts.

milestones.title: Linux Mastery
milestones.outcome: Can administer Linux servers, troubleshoot services, and write robust shell scripts.

tasks.title: Read Linux Filesystem Hierarchy
tasks.description: Study the directory structure and purpose of each top‑level folder in the official Linux Documentation Project.

tasks.title: Practice Bash Scripting Basics
tasks.description: Write a script that backs up /etc to a timestamped tarball and logs the operation.

tasks.title: Configure User Permissions
tasks.description: Create users, groups, and set sudo policies using /etc/sudoers on a VM.

tasks.title: Reflect on Security Practices
tasks.description: Write a short note on least‑privilege principles you applied and gaps to improve.

milestones.title: Git and CI/CD Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can design and maintain CI pipelines and manage complex Git workflows.

tasks.title: Review Git Branching Strategies
tasks.description: Read the Git Flow guide on Atlassian and summarize key steps.

tasks.title: Set Up a GitHub Actions Workflow
tasks.description: Create a workflow that runs lint and unit tests on push to main using a free repo.

tasks.title: Trigger Builds on Pull Requests
tasks.description: Add a job that requires approval before merging and logs the reviewer.

tasks.title: Connect with a CI Community
tasks.description: Join the GitHub Actions Community Forum and introduce yourself.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Deepen container orchestration, IaC, and monitoring expertise.

milestones.title: Docker Advanced Usage
milestones.outcome: Can create multi‑stage images, manage volumes, and debug containers efficiently.

tasks.title: Read Dockerfile Best Practices
tasks.description: Study Docker’s official best‑practice guide on multi‑stage builds.

tasks.title: Build a Multi‑Stage Image
tasks.description: Create an image that compiles a Go binary then copies it into a minimal runtime container.

tasks.title: Debug a Failing Container
tasks.description: Use docker logs, exec, and inspect to troubleshoot a container that exits with error code 1.

tasks.title: Reflect on Image Size Reduction
tasks.description: Document size savings achieved and why they matter for CI speed.

milestones.title: Kubernetes Production Skills
milestones.outcome: Can deploy, scale, and monitor applications on a Kubernetes cluster.

tasks.title: Study the Kubernetes Architecture Docs
tasks.description: Read the official Kubernetes concepts page on control plane components.

tasks.title: Deploy a Sample App with Helm
tasks.description: Use the stable nginx chart to install a web server with custom values.

tasks.title: Configure Horizontal Pod Autoscaling
tasks.description: Create an HPA that scales based on CPU usage and test with load generator.

tasks.title: Connect with K8s Meetups
tasks.description: Attend a virtual Kubernetes meetup and ask a question about production upgrades.

milestones.title: Infrastructure as Code
milestones.outcome: Can provision cloud resources reproducibly using Terraform.

tasks.title: Read Terraform Getting Started Guide
tasks.description: Follow the official Terraform tutorial to provision an AWS S3 bucket.

tasks.title: Write Modular Terraform Code
tasks.description: Create a reusable VPC module with variables for CIDR and subnets.

tasks.title: Practice State Management
tasks.description: Move state to a remote backend (e.g., Terraform Cloud) and lock it during runs.

tasks.title: Reflect on Idempotency
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how your code ensures repeatable deployments.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate end‑to‑end DevOps pipelines.

milestones.title: CI/CD Pipeline for a Web App
milestones.outcome: A public repo showing automated build, test, and deployment to Kubernetes.

tasks.title: Design Pipeline Diagram
tasks.description: Sketch the stages from code commit to production rollout using a free diagram tool.

tasks.title: Implement GitHub Actions CI
tasks.description: Add jobs for lint, unit tests, Docker build, and image push to Docker Hub.

tasks.title: Deploy to a Kind Cluster
tasks.description: Use kubectl to apply manifests generated by the pipeline and verify rollout.

tasks.title: Document the Workflow
tasks.description: Write a README that explains each pipeline step and how to reproduce it.

milestones.title: Containerised Multi‑Service App
milestones.outcome: A Docker‑Compose and Helm setup for a front‑end, API, and database with monitoring.

tasks.title: Compose Multi‑Service Locally
tasks.description: Create a docker-compose.yml that links a React app, Node API, and PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Translate to Helm Charts
tasks.description: Package each service as a Helm chart and deploy to a local cluster.

tasks.title: Add Prometheus Metrics
tasks.description: Instrument the API with Prometheus client library and expose /metrics endpoint.

tasks.title: Connect with Open‑Source Contributors
tasks.description: Open a PR on an example Helm chart repo and discuss improvements.

milestones.title: Terraform‑Defined Infrastructure
milestones.outcome: Terraform code that provisions a VPC, EKS cluster, and CI runner resources.

tasks.title: Plan Full Stack Infra
tasks.description: Write Terraform files for VPC, subnets, and an EKS cluster using the AWS provider.

tasks.title: Integrate CI Runner IAM Role
tasks.description: Create an IAM role for GitHub Actions runners and attach least‑privilege policies.

tasks.title: Run Terraform Apply Safely
tasks.description: Execute a plan in a sandbox account, review changes, and apply.

tasks.title: Reflect on Cost Optimisation
tasks.description: Add tags and enable auto‑scaling to reduce projected monthly spend, then note findings.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish leadership abilities, interview skills, and advanced DevOps topics.

milestones.title: Monitoring and Observability Mastery
milestones.outcome: Can design alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes.

tasks.title: Read Prometheus Alerting Docs
tasks.description: Study the official guide on alert rules and notification channels.

tasks.title: Build Grafana Dashboards
tasks.description: Create a dashboard showing CPU, memory, and request latency for your demo app.

tasks.title: Simulate an Incident
tasks.description: Trigger a high‑latency condition, verify alerts fire, and run a post‑mortem checklist.

tasks.title: Connect with SRE Community
tasks.description: Join the CNCF SRE Slack channel and share your incident report for feedback.

milestones.title: Leadership and Collaboration
milestones.outcome: Can lead DevOps initiatives, mentor teammates, and communicate architecture decisions.

tasks.title: Read Effective DevOps Leadership Article
tasks.description: Study a free article from the DevOps.com leadership series and note three actionable habits.

tasks.title: Facilitate a Mock Retrospective
tasks.description: Run a 30‑minute retrospective with peers on a recent pipeline change, capture action items.

tasks.title: Create a Knowledge Base Page
tasks.description: Document your CI/CD best practices in Confluence or a markdown repo for team use.

tasks.title: Reflect on Coaching Moments
tasks.description: Write a short journal entry about a time you helped a teammate solve a CI issue.

milestones.title: Senior‑Level Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Can confidently answer system‑design, troubleshooting, and culture‑fit questions.

tasks.title: Study System Design for DevOps
tasks.description: Read the free “Designing Scalable Systems” chapter on AWS Architecture Blog.

tasks.title: Practice Whiteboard Design
tasks.description: Sketch a high‑availability CI pipeline on paper, then explain it aloud for 5 minutes.

tasks.title: Mock Technical Interview
tasks.description: Pair with a peer to run a 60‑minute interview focusing on Terraform and Kubernetes scenarios.

tasks.title: Reflect on Feedback
tasks.description: Summarize strengths and gaps identified in the mock interview and plan improvements.
